implementation.requestCancellation: cancel_service_request locks the service request first, rejects the exact active booking statuses used by accept_proposal before any writes, and continues to cancel eligible open/closed requests and reject sent proposals when no active booking exists. It takes sent-proposal row locks with NOWAIT before changing request/proposal rows so an acceptance holding a proposal cannot form a request/proposal lock cycle; callers receive a retryable error.
implementation.bookingReadback: Request detail uses the current booking ID/status/hold from the existing T05 proposal view state. Closed requests with an active hold route to Continue/Manage booking; historical cancelled/expired bookings do not suppress request cancellation.
implementation.existingBookingSafety: The existing cancel_booking path is unchanged and remains available while the proposal acquisition switch is OFF; no alternate request refund path or new feature flag was added.
implementation.concurrency: A private PostgreSQL integration test uses two distinct backend PIDs and service-request row-lock barriers to overlap accept_proposal and cancel_service_request in both lock acquisition orders, prove request-first cancellation blocking, exercise NOWAIT contention against an acceptance-locked proposal, and verify the accepted hold cannot coexist with a cancelled request.
